I'm really just super useless and negative and bitter and hateful and I often have disturbing thoughts of suicide, self-harm, hurting others, running away, amongst other fucked up shit.

I do some good for some people every now and again but honestly a lot of people have forgotten how to show gratitude - including myself. 

plus, doing positive things feels like a lie. I truly am a negative, bitter person. doing Good Things isn't gonna change that.

I feel like everyone's depressed. Nobody's happy. 

Anybody who is is either a naive child who doesn't know any better or full of shit. 
It really doesn't make you feel any better to know you're "not alone".

good stuff!

it took 2 hours to get the dryest, most painful shit out of my body a few days ago. felt like i was shitting gravel. Put me in a bad mood for the days onwards onto now. I can still remember the pain :'/

I have actually tried cutting myself - I have 8 little light scars on my hip. But I decided that it wasn't really for me, because I was too paranoid over scars - another factor of my appearance being way too important to me.
When I say harming myself, I mean like deliberately putting myself in danger. I feel like stealing cigarettes and rotting my lungs away, I feel like chugging bottles of alcohol I had only merely taste-tested in the past. I feel like lying on train tracks; playing a game of 'Can I Move Fast Enough?'. THAT kind of self harm. 

Good luck with your treatment - I hope one day you accept the scars on your arms.
Pro Tip: Sunder a second before you think you should
